title: Citrix DaaS - Application and Machine Performance
description: Application-centric Citrix DaaS dashboard. Filter by Application Name to narrow down every widget, including machine inventory, sessions, connections, ICA/logon performance, and CPU/memory utilization, to the machines running that application. For sources that don't have an Application Name, the dashboard uses a Machine Name join (`sub-query` / `aggregate_filtered_query`) against Application Instance logs.

definition.content:
### Overview

An application-centric Citrix DaaS dashboard. Select an app in the `Application_Name` template variable. Every widget, including usage, sessions, ICA/logon performance, and CPU/memory, automatically filters down to the machines running the application, using a Machine Name join against Application Instance logs.

### Tips
- Use `$Application_Name` to scope the whole dashboard to one application.
- Use `$Machine_Name` / `$User_Name` to go further into a specific VDA or user.
- Clone this dashboard to rearrange, modify, or add widgets.

## Widgets
1. Total Sessions
  2. Unique Users
  3. Total Application Launches
  4. Avg Usage Duration per Launch
  5. Application Instances Over Time by Machine
  6. Application Launches Over Time
  7. Application Instances by Geolocation
  8. Application Instances Details
  9. Avg CPU Utilization
  10. Peak CPU Utilization
  11. Machines Breaching 80% CPU
  12. Avg Memory Utilization
  13. Machines by Application Instance Completion Time
  14. Peak CPU Over Time by Machine
  15. Avg CPU Utilization Over Time by Machine
  16. Avg Memory Usage Over Time by Machine
  17. Average IOPS Over Time
  18. Machine Resource Utilization Details

definition.title: Total Sessions
definition.description: Sessions recorded on machines running the selected application (sub-query joined on Machine Name).

definition.title: Unique Users
definition.description: Unique users who have launched the selected application.

definition.title: Total Application Launches
definition.description: Total launch count for the selected application (Application Activity Summary).

definition.title: Avg Usage Duration per Launch
definition.description: Total usage duration divided by total launches for the selected application.

definition.title: Application Instances Over Time by Machine
definition.description: Instance volume trend for the selected application, broken down by the top machines running it.

definition.title: Application Launches Over Time
definition.description: Tracks how application usage changes over time.

definition.title: Application Instances by Geolocation
definition.description: Geographic distribution of where the selected application is being accessed from.

definition.title: Application Instances Details
definition.description: Provides detailed records of individual application sessions.

definition.title: Resource Utilization Summary - CPU vs Logon Correlation
definition.description: Per-machine CPU, ICA RTT, logon duration, and session load side by side, for machines running the selected application.

definition.title: Avg CPU Utilization
definition.description: Average CPU utilization on machines running the selected application.

definition.title: Peak CPU Utilization
definition.description: Peak CPU utilization on machines running the selected application.

definition.title: Machines Breaching 80% CPU
definition.description: Count of machines running the selected application whose peak CPU exceeded 80%.

definition.title: Avg Memory Utilization
definition.description: Average used memory as a percentage of total memory on machines running the selected application.

definition.title: Machines by Application Instance Completion Time
definition.description: Every machine that has run the selected application, with instance count, unique users, and average completion time. Use this detailed view to see every machine associated with the selected application.

definition.title: Peak CPU Over Time by Machine
definition.description: Peak CPU trend for the top machines running the selected application.

definition.title: Avg CPU Utilization Over Time by Machine
definition.description: CPU utilization trend for the top machines running the selected application.

definition.title: Avg Memory Usage Over Time by Machine
definition.description: Used memory as a percentage of total memory over time for the top machines running the selected application.

definition.title: Average IOPS Over Time
definition.description: Trend of average disk input/output operations per second.

definition.title: Top Machines by Disk Latency and IOPs
definition.description: Machines with the highest disk latency values.

definition.title: Machine Resource Utilization Details
definition.description: Detailed CPU, memory, and logon performance metrics for each machine.
